title: AI structured output with a Zod schema
prompt: The team describes its data with Zod. Create src/triage.ts that exports `triageSchema`, a Zod schema (from the zod package) for an object with `priority` (one of "low", "normal" or "urgent") and `tags` (an array of at most 5 strings), and `export async function triage(ai: AI, text: string)` (the AI type from @browserlessapi/inferlo/ai) that asks the "fast" model alias to triage the support ticket text, using Inferlo's structured output with triageSchema itself (do not write a second schema with t.*), and returns the validated object.
